description: This file defines API routes for managing classes and class sessions in a gym management system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and deleting classes, as well as creating and listing class sessions. The routes handle security dependencies, database interactions, and response models.

methods.name: create_class_endpoint(payload: ClassCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.TRAINER])))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new class, accessible by admin or trainer roles.

methods.name: update_class_endpoint(class_id: int, payload: ClassUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.TRAINER])))
methods.description: Endpoint to update class details, restricted to admin or trainer roles.

methods.name: delete_class_endpoint(class_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.TRAINER])))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a class, restricted to admin or trainer roles.

methods.name: create_session_endpoint(payload: ClassSessionCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.TRAINER])))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new class session, restricted to admin or trainer roles.

methods.name: list_sessions_endpoint(class_id: int | None = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to list class sessions, optionally filtered by class_id.
